name: AI Context Bridge
tagline: Carry a conversation from ChatGPT to Claude to Gemini and back, in seconds.
description: A Chrome extension that saves chat history from any of five AI platforms and injects it into another. Shadow DOM isolation keeps the injected UI clear of host styles; LZ-string compression keeps long conversations under a 5 MB cap; the save button disables while the AI is still generating; and every platform has ordered selector fallbacks against DOM changes.
highlights: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Grok: extract and inject
Native value setter and synthetic events for React and Vue inputs
Keyboard shortcuts, JSON import and export, UUID de-duplication
